feasibility_measured.parquet_layout: trades-0000: 10,000,000 rows / 1,000 row groups of 10,000 rows. parquet_metadata shows stats_min = stats_max = NULL for path_in_schema='ticker'.
feasibility_measured.CONSEQUENCE: There are NO row-group statistics on ticker, so a ticker predicate CANNOT skip row groups. Predicate pushdown on ticker is NOT cheap in the sense DATA_SOURCES.md implies: it reduces bytes for the other columns but still forces a full read of the ticker column of every shard. Any plan that re-scans the tape once per series is infeasible.
feasibility_measured.MANDATED_PLAN: ONE shared pass over all 16 trade shards, shard-at-a-time, each shard's output written to venue_expansion/cache/prereg/tape/ before the next shard starts. That single pass emits (a) the U1 per-(unit, calendar-day, side, price-decile) aggregate and (b) raw filtered trades for the M1/D1/J1 ticker universes. Every spec then reads local parquet. No spec may re-scan the remote tape.
